name: app-remises
description: Sistema de gestión y viajes de Remises Bruno (App Clientes + App Interna + Backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:clientes" "npm run dev:interno"
scripts.build: npm run build:clientes && npm run build:interno && npm run build:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend-clientes && npm install && cd ../frontend-interno && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push

author: RzCore
